qmljsdebugger_port.description: QML/JS debugger port, format: port:1234[,block]; leave empty to disable

window_geometry.description: Window geometry in X11 syntax: WIDTHxHEIGHT+X+Y (e.g., 1000x600+100+50)

window_icon.description: Path to default window icon file

platform.description: QPA platform plugin name with optional parameters (e.g., 'wayland' or 'xcb:displays=:0')

plugins.description: List of additional plugin paths or names to load at startup

session_path.description: Path to session file to restore application state from

appstream_url.description: AppStream URL to open on startup (e.g., 'appstream://com.deepin.Stock')
